name: Laharl
source:
Likes: Himself
Dislikes: Love, kindness, and sexy bodies

Former Overlord, Krichevskoy, is his father.

He lives selfishly and he is the best.
He became an Overlord after overcoming many obstacles, but he gets called Prince.
Recently, his personality had rounded out a little more. Apparently, he has a very embarrassing secret that he's never told.

[From Disgaea Infinite's "Netherworld Database".]
